The '''Evarrian Queen''' was a type of [[Evarrian]] native to [[Jagomir]]. Queens could only lay 4-6 eggs per year, and the eggs hatch between 2 and 3 months. The queen is protected by 4 [[Evarrian hunter]]s at the nest, and the evarrians want to protect their nest when the [[Ardan resistance]] arrives on Jagomir.
